stories.title: Workers at Deeside Industrial Park could get earlier, later and weekend buses
stories.summary: Earlier, later and weekend buses are being planned to get shift workers to Deeside Industrial Park and Hawarden Industrial Estate, if new funding is approved. stories.title: Airbus Broughton workers take on Moel Famau charity walk for men’s health
stories.summary: Workers from Airbus Broughton have walked up Moel Famau to raise money for Movember. Staff from across the business took part in the charity walk, which was organised by Elfyn Davies. stories.title: “This meeting is a farce”: Flintshire councillors vote down nine of ten motions
stories.summary: Calls to act on flooding, school transport, housing development and the cost of a new Catholic school were all voted down at a special meeting of Flintshire County Council on Tuesday. stories.title: Broughton flood work delayed as council rejects call for more defence money
stories.summary: Flood defence work in Broughton that was due to start in the summer has been put back, with a new start now proposed for December or January, a councillor has told Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Fifteen affordable homes and office planned for Garden City
stories.summary: Fifteen affordable homes and a small office are planned for a site next to Sealand Primary School in Garden City. Housing association ClwydAlyn has applied to Flintshire County Council to build nine three-bedroom and six two-bedroom houses on Plot 5 at Northern Gateway, off John Summers Way.
